genotype_to_drug_rule: Under primary reading who_assoc, calls R when any reported dr_variant carries WHO catalogue v2 grade 'Assoc w R' or 'Assoc w R - Interim'. When no resistant variant is called and any drug target region has <100% assembly coverage, emits no_call; otherwise S. Resistant calls take precedence over incomplete coverage.

i_handling.description: TBProfiler does not emit an I category; ungraded and Uncertain significance variants are excluded under who_assoc and any I token is counted separately and never mapped to S.
